image_description: A close-up photograph of a butterfly, identified as a Ringlet (Erebia aethiops or similar Satyrid), resting on a textured grey rock surface. The butterfly's wings are held closed, displaying a ventral pattern of greyish-brown scales with distinct orange patches and black eyespots (ocelli) ringed in white. The body is fuzzy and brown, and the antennae are visible with clubbed tips. The background consists of out-of-focus rocks and sparse vegetation.
